Consequently the F_competition incumbent cannot be improved by any method within this model, and the 10s budget was sufficient to prove optimality (solver_seconds 1.78, branches 39752, conflicts 6171). Remaining research value lies in robustness and cost, not in further makespan reduction: testing whether the optimal schedules are stable across seeds/models, and whether cheaper methods (rules, RL) can match the optimum at lower tool cost, which matters for the secondary cost comparison.
